title: Function invocation sanity scanner: config-delta triggered eval for selector + arg validation
creator: Ava Nakamura
description: Build a lightweight, config-delta triggered evaluation harness that continuously probes function/tool selection accuracy and argument validation when model or serving configuration changes. The scanner should run targeted micro-evals after changes to: model version, quantization profile, kernel selection, batching config, and routing policy. The goal is to detect regressions in (a) correct tool selection decisions, and (b) argument shape/serialization errors introduced by model/config shifts before they hit production traffic.
acceptance_criteria: Harness runs automatically on merges to runtime/model-configs and on deployments to staging/dedicated pools
Detects selection accuracy drop >= 3% on our curated functional prompt set and opens an alert ticket
Captures argument-level validation errors (type coercion, missing required fields, shape mismatches) and surfaces example failing inputs + minimal reproducer
Reports a compact diff: baseline metrics vs new run (selection accuracy, arg-pass rate, avg latency) and uploads artifacts to the eval dashboard
Has a CI gate mode: failures can block canary rollout for protected routes when configured by policy
implementation_plan: Spike: collect representative functional prompts for 8 high-risk tool routes (2/10–2/12)
Engineer harness core: runner, comparator, artifact uploader (2/13–2/20)
Integrate with config-change hook: runtime-config repo webhooks and model catalog change events (2/18–2/24)
Add CI gating and release policy flags in rollout controller (2/22–2/28)
Iterate on thresholds and false-positive tuning with PM/Design (2/25–3/01)
testing_plan: Unit tests for comparator logic and arg validation parsers
Synthetic regression tests: inject known argument-shuffle bug and assert harness catches it
Shadow runs on staging traffic for 48h to measure noise and tunables
Manual review of first 10 failures by oncall + tool owners to refine acceptance criteria
risks: False positives from natural model drift leading to alert fatigue
Execution cost if harness runs on large prompt corpora too frequently
Potential leak: example inputs could contain customer data if not sanitized
Timing: gating rollouts without mature tuning may delay deliveries
